user.title: Set up HACraft
user.description: This turns on the websocket commands your HACraft Minecraft mod connects to. There's nothing to fill in here - inside Minecraft, generate a long-lived access token from your Home Assistant profile (Settings > your profile > Security) and enter this instance's URL and the token in the mod's Home Server block.

init.title: Choose what Minecraft can see
init.description: Pick the entities the HACraft Minecraft mod is allowed to list, watch, and control. Anything not picked here is invisible to the mod, even if a player types its entity_id in-game.
